title: Writing / Style / Dashes
slide_intent: Use different dash marks for different jobs so compounds, ranges and conversational pauses remain distinguishable.
strategic_value: Explicit streak and adverb exceptions can help Duolingo avoid mechanical punctuation edits that change its established style.
demonstration: Three groups explain hyphens, en dashes and em dashes with approved and rejected examples.
practical_value: Identify the mark’s purpose and check the local exceptions before replacing it.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the Dashes heading and brief introduction to three marks at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack compound-word guidance, range guidance and sentence-break guidance at right with paired examples below each.

reference_purposes.Application: Examples contrast compound words, date/time ranges and a sentence split.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The guide excludes hyphens in x day streak and after -ly modifiers, uses unspaced en dashes for ranges, and prefers two sentences to em dashes; unavoidable em dashes have spaces on both sides.

ingredient.name: Dash selection
ingredient.role: Make compounds, ranges and pauses distinguishable.
ingredient.application: Use hyphens for compound adjectives except -ly modifiers and x day streak; use unspaced en dashes for ranges; prefer two sentences to an em dash, spacing an unavoidable em dash on both sides.
ingredient.scope: Historical official guidelines from the 2024–2025 archived snapshot; this records the displayed guidance, not current Duolingo product behavior.
